description: This file implements the 'Library' class, which manages dynamic library loading, symbol resolution, reference counting, and unloading, with platform-specific handling for Windows and Linux.

classes.name: Library
classes.description: A class for managing dynamic library handles, including loading, symbol resolution, reference counting, and unloading.

methods.name: Library()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing an empty library handle.

methods.name: Library(const void* functionInLibrary)
methods.description: Constructs a Library object by obtaining a handle from a function pointer within a library.

methods.name: Library(const TCHAR fileName[])
methods.description: Constructs a Library object by loading a library from a filename.

methods.name: operator=(const Library& RHS)
methods.description: Copy assignment operator, manages reference counting.

methods.name: LoadFunction(const TCHAR functionName[]) const
methods.description: Loads a function symbol from the library.

methods.name: WaitUnloaded(const uint32_t timeout)
methods.description: Waits until the library is unloaded or timeout occurs.

methods.name: AddRef()
methods.description: Increments the reference count of the library handle.

methods.name: Release()
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and unloads the library if count reaches zero.
